summary_zh: FreeToken 是面向个人与消费级硬件的边缘原生 MoE 推理引擎，可将 GPU、CPU、主机内存和互连视为统一弹性推理平台，在本地运行前沿开源 MoE 模型，并提供语义感知缓存、弹性显存管理及 Anthropic/OpenAI 兼容 API，可供编码与工具调用类智能体接入。
audience_zh: 适合希望在个人电脑或工作站本地运行大规模 MoE 模型、并需要兼容 API 接入编码或工具调用智能体的开发者；也适合使用 NVIDIA RTX 30/40/50 系列显卡的消费级硬件用户。

evidence.quote: FreeToken is an edge-native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) serving engine designed for running frontier-scale open-weight models on personal and consumer hardware. It treats heterogeneous edge resources—GPUs, CPUs, host memory, and interconnects—as a unified, elastic inference platform. Its core features include:

- **Broad MoE & Ecosystem Support**: Supports frontier open-weight MoE models (e.g., DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, GLM-5.2) across various parameter scales and quantization formats (e.g., MXFP4, NVFP4, FP8, BF16), with Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible APIs for seamless integration with real-world c
- **Diverse Consumer Hardware**: Scales across consumer laptops, gaming desktops, and workstation GPUs, with native support for NVIDIA RTX 30, RTX 40, and RTX 50 series GPUs.
